title: Symbolic Body Crosswalk Method — Comparing Without Collapsing
purpose: Define how anatomical structures, physiological processes, subjective experience, historical body symbolism and Potatoverse symbols may be compared without converting resemblance into identity or proof.

layer_stack.question: What structure/process is established in anatomy or physiology?
What bodily sensation, perception or lived experience is being described?
What documented tradition or history of ideas associated meaning with this body region/process?
What role does the Potatoverse assign?
What abstract relation is shared, if any: boundary, routing, centrality, timing, flow, branching, storage, threshold?
What conclusion does the comparison not establish?

correspondence_types.definition: Name/etymology creates a real historical language bridge.
correspondence_types.strength_note: Supports history of terminology, not theology.

correspondence_types.definition: Biological function resembles a project operator.
correspondence_types.strength_note: Requires accurate function and explicit abstraction.

correspondence_types.definition: Relative position/connectivity resembles a symbolic layout.
correspondence_types.strength_note: Spatial analogy is not causal identity.

correspondence_types.definition: A biological transition resembles a project transformation sequence.
correspondence_types.example: dormancy → sprout compared with latent → emergence

correspondence_types.definition: Subjective bodily experience is compared with symbolic language.
correspondence_types.strength_note: Does not identify an unmeasured physiological cause.

correspondence_types.definition: A historical thinker/tradition explicitly made a body-symbol association.
correspondence_types.example: Descartes and the pineal in his own historical physiology
correspondence_types.strength_note: Historical precedent can be real while the old physiology is obsolete.
Highest pareidolia risk unless independently documented.

correspondence_types.definition: The same abstract systems problem recurs.
correspondence_types.example: boundary, feedback, source-sink flow, integration, branching

anti_collapse_tests: Could several different organs fit the same metaphor equally well?
Does the mapping depend on a simplified or false biological description?
Is a historical symbolic source actually contemporaneous with the tradition being claimed?
Does the project symbol describe function, location, experience or merely visual resemblance?
Would the symbolic claim survive if the anatomical metaphor were changed?
Is a subjective sensation being misreported as measured biology?
Is the comparison being used as proof of supernatural causation beyond the evidence?

mature_example_shape.title: Thalamus ↔ House
mature_example_shape.biology: Paired heterogeneous diencephalic structures participating in multiple thalamocortical systems.
mature_example_shape.historical_bridge: The anatomical name has chamber/room etymology and a history of architectural naming.
mature_example_shape.shared_relation: central interior differentiated chambers + routing relation
mature_example_shape.boundary: Useful linguistic/functional/topological correspondence; not proof that the thalamus is literally a divine house.
